notes.title: Spork going free-to-play
notes.notes:
Hi all, 
I'm planning to take Spork: The Manic Utensil storm free-to-play in the near future. 

When I initially released at $10 I realized with a day or two that that was too much, but because of the launch discount was bound to that price for a period of time. I eventually dropped to $3 but at that point the game had dropped out of the "New Games" section. 

In an effort to get the game to as many folks as possible, I'm planning to take Spork free-to-play. It probably should have been free-to-play(or much closer to it) from the start, but lesson learned.

A special thank you to all who did support the game before this.

notes.title: Release date(10 days!) and demo update
notes.notes:
Hey folks, 

the release date for Spork is currently set to February 15th and we're sticking to that barring any unforeseen issues or acts of god. Hope to see you there!

The demo has also been updated with the latest build if you're interested. Mostly balance tweaks that came from going through the rest of the game in detail. If you've already played, don't expect too much different.

notes.title: Demo releasing on Saturday!
notes.notes:
Hey folks! Like the title says, the demo for Spork: The Manic Utensil Storm should be available by Saturday. It will likely be available late Friday, US times.

Play the first part of the game early, and for free!
